threads.body:
This will resolve https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/16553
This is also used for the span name or metro controller span in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/8671b5a69676c8f3748b7a6e1ce6a55ebef51fea/instrumentation/jaxws/jaxws-metro-2.2/javaagent/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/metro/MetroSingletons.java#L20 that would use the fallback `<unspecified span name>` when this method returns null? @trask is that fine or should we come up with different fallback name?
As far as I can tell cxf instrumentation skips creating the controller span when span name is null.

replies.body: I think we most typically provide an intentional fallback span name (e.g. `db.system.name`), I've sent https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/16796
